entries.24aea8c35a094b9c: This business develops and sells real estate and operates commercial facilities in the United States and other countries. It is carried out by subsidiaries including HASEKO America, Inc., which operates commercial facilities and is developing a new detached-house sales business on Oahu, Hawaii. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,314 million, up 24.5% from ¥3,466 million in the previous fiscal year, but this is the smallest business among the four reportable segments. Ten U.S. companies are listed as major equity-method associates, and the voting rights held in all of them are 50.0% (indirect ownership). In October 2025, HASEKO UK LIMITED was established in the United Kingdom. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the name of this reportable segment was changed from 'Overseas Related Business' to 'Overseas Business'.
entries.391dedbee5123940: This is the condominium building management category, the largest category within the Management and Operation Business. As of March 31, 2026, the number of managed units was 448,076 units (5,682 buildings), an increase of 1.1% from 443,331 units (5,667 buildings) at the end of the previous fiscal year. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥69,126 million, up 4.8% from ¥65,966 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.4472f17c6462a361: Items not included in the categories above; no description of its content is provided. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,341 million, up 9.9% from ¥3,949 million in the previous fiscal year.

entries.837e9b6494d9d0eb: This category covers the leasing of apartments and other properties within the Management and Operation Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,491 million, up 2.0% from ¥12,245 million in the previous fiscal year.

entries.ade7e016828c8f01: This category covers interior construction and other construction work. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,307 million, up 3.8% from ¥28,224 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.bef9796406029037: This category covers the leasing management of rental condominiums. Haseko Livenet Co., Ltd. and others are responsible for it. As of March 31, 2026, the number of managed units was 185,511 units, up from 184,035 units at the end of the previous fiscal year. Revenue for this category is not shown separately.
entries.ded7f75496354bde: A corporate group centered on the construction of condominiums for sale, which also handles real estate sales, condominium management and the operation of fee-based nursing homes.
entries.e727a34d2f9152d7: This category covers the operation of paid nursing homes and senior housing; Haseko Senior Well Design Co., Ltd. operates paid nursing homes and the long-term care insurance business. As of March 31, 2026, the quantity was 2,961 units and the number in operation was 2,786, compared with 2,992 units and 2,717 at the end of the previous fiscal year; the quantity decreased and the number in operation increased. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,608 million, up 8.1% from ¥17,209 million in the previous fiscal year.
